notes: PAPER LICENCE: not applicable. There is no data-descriptor paper for this database. PhysioNet directs citation to Kemp, Zwinderman, Tuk, Kamphuisen & Oberye (2000), IEEE Trans. Biomed. Eng. 47(9):1185-1194, which is about slow-wave microcontinuity rather than about the database, and which is IEEE paywalled. source.md is therefore a snapshot of the canonical PhysioNet landing page, which is the primary documentation of the recording; pdf_status is not-applicable and md_quality is clean (the page is single-column prose and the extraction preserves it as written, including the per-study sampling-rate paragraphs and the Access block). DATA LICENCE, read verbatim from the Access block on the landing page: 'Access Policy: Anyone can access the files, as long as they conform to the terms of the specified license. License (for files): Open Data Commons Attribution License v1.0'. ODC-BY is a redistributable attribution licence for the data files themselves; that applies to the data, not to this snapshot of the page. redistribution_ok is set false here because it governs whether a source.pdf may be committed in this entry folder, and there is no PDF to commit -- it is not a statement about the data licence, which is recorded above. NOTE ON THE STRAND BRIEF's registry sweep: PhysioNet is not well covered by citation search, and this entry was found by browsing the registry directly, with the landing page recorded as source_url as the brief instructs. The dataset DOI 10.13026/C2X676 is PhysioNet's own version DOI, not a Crossref journal DOI, so `opencite lookup` does not resolve it; Crossref has no record.
